entry_points.summary: Haiku lookup worker with fixed contract and read-only tools
STATUS-headed Markdown envelope and section order
Regex guard refusing mutating Bash before execution
3 KB response cap plus raw artifact cache rules
UTC retrieval timestamp and stale cache confidence rule
ok, partial, refused meanings and refusal categories

invariants: First line is exactly STATUS: ok|partial|refused.
Sections appear in order: Answer, Provenance, Unresolved, optional Raw artifact pointer.
Total response including STATUS and all sections is <=3 KB.
Answer never dumps raw HTML, JSON, or YAML.
Bash commands are checked against verb-blocklist before execution.
Provenance records Bash commands verbatim, never truncated.
gotchas: 4xx/5xx fetches become partial and get one fallback attempt.
Matched mutation patterns refuse with mutation_blocked; do not sanitize and run.
Authenticated endpoints without secrets refuse as auth_missing.
Raw artifact pointer is used for overflow under z-harness/lookup-cache/<sha256>.raw.
